hero.title: Why Choose Corridor?
hero.subtitle: We're not just another payment platform. We're your business orchestration partner.

reasons.title: Ship Faster
reasons.description: Integrate once, access all payment providers. No more juggling multiple APIs or dealing with inconsistent documentation.

reasons.title: Built for Reliability
reasons.description: Automatic failover, intelligent retry logic, and real-time monitoring ensure your payments never fail.

reasons.title: Smart Orchestration
reasons.description: Our AI-powered routing finds the best payment path for each transaction, optimizing for cost and success rate.

reasons.title: Developer First
reasons.description: Beautiful docs, comprehensive SDKs, and a playground environment. Built by developers, for developers.

reasons.title: Deep Insights
reasons.description: Real-time analytics, custom reports, and actionable insights help you understand your payment flows.

reasons.title: Human Support
reasons.description: Talk to real humans who understand payments. No bots, no scripts, just genuine help when you need it.
